units.prompt:
{STYLE}
FORMAT: landscape 16:9 (2048x1152), army lineup sheet on a dark ink-navy background, eight full-body figures standing on one ground line, left to right, correct relative sizes, a thin gold rule under their feet and a Chinese label under each figure: 普通亡魂, 复仇亡魂, 缝合巨人, 盾骷髅, 死灵骑士, 巫妖, 旗手亡魂, 亡魂王子. No other text.
SUBJECT: the undead fleet. Every figure is clearly dead: skeletons or ashen stitched flesh, cyan-green soulfire in eyes and wounds, cyan-green rim light. Shared costume language: ragged faded navy sailors' and marines' clothing, torn purple cloth, broken-crown badges, rope and anchor details.
1 普通亡魂: skeleton marine with a short sword and a round anchor-badge shield, loose-jointed, slightly comic.
2 复仇亡魂: lean skeleton leaning forward in a sprint, rags streaming, soulfire leaking from the ribs.
3 缝合巨人: a huge stitched dockworker (about twice the height of the others), grey patched skin, sleeves of different colours, swinging a ship's anchor on a rope; a gentle face.
4 盾骷髅: skeleton hunched behind a tall door-plank shield with an anchor painted on it.
5 死灵骑士: skeleton rider in battered marine armour on a skeletal horse, lance with a purple pennant.
6 巫妖: robed skeletal caster, hood, floating parchment, a lantern of soulfire.
7 旗手亡魂: skeleton holding a tall pole with a torn purple banner bearing a broken gold crown, a bugle at the hip.
8 亡魂王子: Edmund exactly as in the reference hero art: split face (anatomical left half skull with flame, right half human), snapped gold crown, ivory-gold armour, purple cape, soulfire sword.

{STYLE}
FORMAT: landscape 16:9 (2048x1152), army lineup sheet on a dark ink-navy background, eight full-body figures on one ground line with correct relative sizes, a thin gold rule under their feet and a Chinese label under each: 民兵, 盾兵, 枪兵, 弓兵, 弩手, 修士, 传令兵, 王国骑士. No other text.
SUBJECT: the living kingdom's defenders. ALL OF THEM ARE LIVING HUMANS with healthy skin and real faces, NO skulls, no undead features, warm ivory-gold rim light. Shared costume language: white and royal-blue tabards with a gold eight-rayed sun, regency units add a red diagonal band, kettle helmets and simple steel.
1 民兵: nervous farmer-conscript with a spear and a padded jacket, too-big helmet.
2 盾兵: disciplined soldier behind a large round sun shield, short sword.
3 枪兵: long pike braced, half-plate.
4 弓兵: longbow, quiver of fire arrows, one arrow lit.
5 弩手: heavy crossbow and a pavise shield on his back.
6 修士: priest in white with a gold sun, holding a flask of holy water and a hand bell.
7 传令兵: lightly dressed runner with a signal horn and a lit torch, mid-run.
8 王国骑士: armoured knight with a sun-crest helm, long shield and a red regency band.

Match the frame design of the reference dialogue screen exactly.
